summary: Independently audited the strongest round-5 claim (student-2 s2_010/post_020: the order-3 Q-wall brick 'closed' as G_{m;pq}=-16 max(w_m^2,w_t^2), orbit R_Q=-16 sum (Q_{m;pq})_+^3 [w_m^2+(q_mt)_+], no energy-sign selector) plus student-1's 18-wall completeness. Built a fresh md5-matched bg_r5 and reimplemented P_pole, R_spline, Q_T, and the candidate brick/orbit from the written formulas (no student evaluator). REFUTED the brick: the -16 max selector fails at 24 of 27 independently extracted isolated Q-wall crossings (right only in special cells like the canonical worked example, where w_1=2 w_5 makes -16 w_m^2 = -32 w_m w_t). Found and verified the CORRECT cofactor G_{m;pq}=-32 w_m w_t: R_spline - R_Q^corr with R_Q^corr=-32 sum (Q_{m;pq})_+^3 w_m w_t is smooth across all 27 isolated Q-walls (9 channels, 4 energy-sign chambers). The correct brick is simpler (plain degree-2 monomial, no max/nested part, auto-continuous) and IS energy-sign dependent, contradicting student-2's 'no sign selector'. Confirmed the order-3 structure (Q^3-divisible, not Q^4, degree-2 cofactor) and corroborated student-1's 18-wall set (23/23 magnitude-order-change segments are single polynomials). No complete compact A_6 (G1 persists).

checks_rerun_result.V4_wallset_completeness: CORROBORATED (23/23 segments with interior magnitude-order changes but no q/Q crossing are single degree-8 polynomials; no hidden wall found). Rank-285 chamber fit NOT independently rebuilt.

gaps_found.text: student-2's round-5 order-3 Q-brick is FALSE as a global formula: G=-16max(w_m^2,w_t^2) / R_Q=-16 sum (Q)_+^3[w_m^2+(q_mt)_+] fails at 24/27 isolated Q-walls, and 'no energy-sign selector' is false. Correct brick (verifier finding, 27/27): G_{m;pq}=-32 w_m w_t, R_Q^corr=-32 sum (Q_{m;pq})_+^3 w_m w_t. Must be re-derived/confirmed by the students before use, but it is strongly evidenced. Do not build round 6 on the -16max brick.

No complete compact A_6 (G1 persists). Even with the corrected Q-brick, the global symmetric R_0 and the order-1 q-fan assembly (H_mp) are unbuilt/unverified and no table-free full evaluator exists. Next: subtract R_Q^corr, confirm the remainder is a pure 9-wall q-spline + R_0, solve R_0, assemble, and hand a full A_6 candidate to the verifier. student-2's claimed q-Q coupling correction to H_mt is moot (corrected brick has no nested q_mt part).

Wall-set completeness (18 hyperplanes) corroborated empirically (no hidden wall found off the q/Q arrangement) but not proven; the rank-285 dual-S3 chamber fit was not independently reproduced and a symbolic completeness argument is still owed.

BG is exactly singular (SIGFPE) on walls/poles; near-wall work must use two-sided limits off the wall. Factorization poles inside a chamber are removable in R_spline (skipping those BG points does not break polynomial reconstruction).
